items.title: Harry Shields Interview, 1961-05-28
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] By the way, Dick Allen, who works with us up at Tulane... [INTERVIEWEE] He's a great fellow.

ctx.x: Well, I wouldn't say every night, John, but they sure do their share of business. Yeah. And, of course, weekends there, why, the place is just jammed, you know. And, uh, every night they have their quota, you know, people. And also the Metropole, they... They're just about here. Of course, they, they use both the... Modern and... And Dick's 20. Mm-hmm . Mm-hmm .
